name: Seismic Smash rank 1 comes from the Mountain King talent, not the trainer (#7555)
contract: Seismic Smash rank 1 (300693) is the Mountain King capstone, CharacterAdvancement entry 7498, which needs 23
points invested in its tab. #7555 could not find it because the reporter had not invested them. Teaching it
at Mathrengyl Bearwalker (creature 4217, trainer 900031) and listing it in AscensionCompatData::ClassSpells
let any level 59 Primalist skip the capstone, and PersistentRank then counted the capstone as owned, so every
switch to Mountain King was refused for missing tab investment. At level 60 the trainer window must not list
rank 1 and the spell must not be granted; Greater Earthen Endurance's rank 1 row (570756, level 60) is the
control that the window lists ordinary rank-1 rows.
